title: Wilkins 950XL repair kits by size, check scope, and part number
description: Match a Zurn Wilkins 950XL double check assembly to its official 3/4–1 inch or 1 1/4–2 inch standard, complete, rubber, seat, or check-cover kit.
summary: The 950XL is a double-check assembly, not a 975XL reduced-pressure assembly. Zurn publishes separate kit prefixes for the 3/4–1 and 1 1/4–2 inch size bands.
statusNote: Do not substitute 950XL3 or 975XL data. Confirm the body label and nominal size, then select the smallest repair scope supported by the confirmed failed component.
diagramAlt: Double check backflow assembly with two check covers and shutoff valves
identifiers: The 950XL is a double-check assembly for polluted-water applications; do not apply reduced-pressure 975XL relief-valve kit data.
The repair-kit prefix changes from RK34 to RK114 after the 1 inch / 1 1/4 inch size boundary.
Standard, complete, rubber, seat, and cover kits solve different scopes; a visible cover leak does not establish an internal check failure.
